<!-- pr-reviewer: 027a46fbc0100c9ae8297619f7fff2087c99208f -->
Needs changes before merge.

The code uses the stored profile and the existing floor calculation for an unchanged machine-default holder. Explicit bodies and changed drafts keep their preview path. The seven new tests passed.

Local results after a trial merge with upstream/main `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425`:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. This command produced a plan only. The plan included changes from main because the trial merge was not committed. The tests below cover this PR's UI changes.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 831 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test theme_files`: 25 passed, 0 failed (3, 6, 2, and 14).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

All commands ran locally in the foreground. UI tests ran from `crates/ui`. Direct Cargo commands used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache`. No GitHub runner was used.

Required before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:36` — The PR changes the tool editor display, but the PR body has no before-and-after screenshots. Add images of the same machine-default holder before and after the change. Show the parameter-cylinder floor clearly. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the PR body. Do not add images or review evidence to the PR branch.

Safety scope: the changed function supplies bands only to the editor painter. This PR does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry algorithms. No golden files changed. I did not repeat the author's mutation tests; no red/green mutation result is claimed by this review. The safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply to this display-only change.

The merge is clean. The missing screenshots are the only blocking finding. The PR stays in draft with `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The only review finding is addressed. The PR body now links before-and-after screenshots of the same machine-default holder. The parameter-cylinder floor is clearly visible. The images live only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `e370f94f4353a7c1b38f18a4dd9769cb9a7d781c`.

Pin: `pr2041_before_after_screenshot_links`. Removing either link fails (RED). Restoring both links passes (GREEN). Both URLs return valid PNG images. `machine_default_editor_envelope_matches_checked_parameter_floor` also passes.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 822 UI tests and 25 integration tests passed; 6 were ignored. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Head: `027a46fbc0100c9ae8297619f7fff2087c99208f`. It is unchanged because this finding required images only. Plain push reported up to date. No source commit was added. The PR remains a draft. Labels are unchanged.

Please re-review.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 027a46fbc0100c9ae8297619f7fff2087c99208f -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I withdraw the earlier request for changes on this head. Finding 1 at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:36` is now answered. The PR body links before-and-after images of the same holder. I opened both images. The after image shows the amber envelope over the full parameter holder: radius 30 mm, from 60 to 120 mm above the tip. The before image shows only the smaller stored body. Both files are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `e370f94f4353a7c1b38f18a4dd9769cb9a7d781c`. No images or review evidence were added to the PR branch.

The code head is unchanged. The stored profile supplies the display bands for an unchanged machine-default holder. Explicit bodies and changed drafts keep their preview path. All seven new tests passed.

Local checks passed after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `17a8c6e7608bb7078f75ec335361839712e51425`:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 831 passed, 6 ignored, 0 failed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --test boundary --test boundary_picks --test sinker_setup --test theme_files`: 25 passed, 0 failed. Counts: 3, 6, 2, and 14.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. This was a plan only. The uncommitted trial merge caused the plan to include changes from main.

All commands ran locally in the foreground, one at a time, in the review worktree. UI tests ran from `crates/ui`. Cargo used `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache` and the worktree's own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

Safety scope: the changed function supplies bands only to the editor painter. It does not change posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, or geometry algorithms. No golden files changed. The safety-tier mutation requirement does not apply. I did not run mutations and claim no red/green mutation result.

No required changes remain. GitHub reports `MERGEABLE`. The review label will be `merge-ready`. The author is mkinney, so the draft will be marked ready as requested.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
